BiblicalUsage: Yebemeth is the sister-in-law, the brother's wife in the law of levirate marriage. If a man would not take his brother's wife, she went up to the gate to accuse him before the elders, and Naomi called Ruth's sister-in-law when Orpah turned back to her people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the law of the brother's wife is the law of loyalty, and Ruth stayed when Orpah went back.
